findings.specText: story-052 Story Overview: "so that the adapter can only store routes where the router actually delivers tokenOut"; Technical Details step 7: "Executed swapParams rows must have swap_type != 0 and != 9 (9 is rejected by Router NG v1.1)"
findings.specSource: story doc 052-curve-amm-adapter-route-contiguity-m01.md (Story Overview; Technical Details step 7; Concerns bullet 3)
findings.actualBehavior: Implementation is exactly the story's denylist {0, 9}; swap_type 10..type(uint256).max are accepted and stored (profiler probe test_swapTypeAboveNineAccepted PASS). Router NG v1.1 dispatches only 1..8, so such a route reverts on every swap, freezing the market strategy's deposit/withdraw/skim until the owner overwrites it (recoverable, fail-loud, no stranding).
findings.deviation: Not an implementation deviation - the code follows step 7 to the letter. The story itself under-enumerates the router's rejected set relative to its own stated goal, and both NatSpec sites (CurveAMMAdapter.sol:91-92, ICurveRouterNG.sol:19-20) inherit the story's wording, reading as if swap_type validity is enforced. Same spec gap the owner already triaged as QA in sya-harvester (sh2l5 / 3dc3002290, swap_type >= 9, 2026-10-26).
findings.recommendation: Amend story-052 (or a follow-up) to an allowlist: if (swapType == 0 || swapType > 8) revert InvalidRouteSwapParams(h). Avoid the 'st - 1 >= 8' idiom (panics 0x11 on 0).
findings.dedupGuidance: Same root cause as LOCAL-002. Merge into ONE ledger entry (the code-level LOCAL-002 fingerprint) and carry this as its spec-conformance face; do not file two entries.

findings.function: AMM Route Configuration > Adding new routes
findings.specText: src/CLAUDE.md:258: "`test/unit/CurveAMMAdapter.routeGap.t.sol` asserts every route in this file passes; add a case there when adding a Curve route."
findings.actualBehavior: test_routeGap_canonicalAMMRoutesAccepted (test/unit/CurveAMMAdapter.routeGap.t.sol:368-382) parses two hard-coded keys, 'USDe-sUSDe' and 'sUSDe-USDe'. It does not enumerate the file. A route added to AMMRoutes.json without a matching test case is not asserted.
findings.deviation: The story's own criterion ('assert in a test that both its routes pass') is met. The CLAUDE.md sentence claims a stronger, enumerating guarantee ('every route') that does not hold. The same sentence's instruction to add a case partly mitigates this. Decision 5's rationale ('hardcoding ... would not catch future edits to the file') is true only for edits to the two existing entries.
findings.recommendation: Reword to 'asserts both canonical USDe<->sUSDe routes pass', or iterate vm.parseJsonKeys over .Curve.RouterNG.routes.
